title: Network Recommendations Screen
prompt:
Title: Network Recommendations Screen
Context: Task referral screen for HoneyDo2Done, helping users transition from a stuck task to finding outside help through their network.
Description of the screen: An empowering 'Get recommendations' screen with a deep charcoal black (#0D0D0D) background. At the top, the title 'Tap your network' in bold white with the subtitle 'Your friends probably know someone great' in muted gray. A central card (#1A1A1A) with 12px rounded corners displays a pre-written message: 'Anyone know a good plumber? We have a dripping faucet that needs professional help.', including a small honey gold edit icon in the corner. Below, a 2x2 grid of share destination buttons: 'Text Message', 'Facebook', 'Nextdoor', and 'Copy Link'. Each button is a dark gray card with a subtle border and a clean, minimal icon. At the very bottom, a 'Skip for now' link in muted gray text. The design is clean, focused, and designed to turn a blocker into a proactive next step.
Platform: web
Form factor: desktop
